evidence_items.explanation: SpartQA documents substantive spatial reasoning coverage before the post. It rules out an interpretation that spatial reasoning was entirely untested, but does not establish coverage of most forms across the February 2023 inventory.

PIQA provides a concrete physical commonsense dataset with reported human and model performance. Its existence establishes some measurement capability, but not comprehensive category coverage or a validated broad commonsense score.

This independent survey identifies remaining gaps while proposing groups of physical reasoning benchmarks. It concerns a later inventory and does not quantify the claim that most forms were untested in February.

unresolved_gaps: No independent audit found establishes how many meaningful spatial and physical reasoning categories the February 2023 inventory covered collectively.
The available sources do not establish whether a broad commonsense measure met a defensible reliability and validity standard.
Evidence that individual benchmarks omit capabilities does not establish that those capabilities are absent from every benchmark.
